text.what: The UC Davis programme that holds, tests and distributes certified grapevine material in the United States. The numbers on American clones — UCD 4, UCD 2A — are its numbers.
text.how: Imported vines go through quarantine and virus testing before release. That process is why certified material is slow and expensive, and why suitcase cuttings keep happening.
